note: A political campaign. If you lived through the Mao years, 运动 on its own means the next round of denunciations, and hearing one is coming makes you uneasy.

gloss: we or us (including both the speaker and the person(s) spoken to)
note: We, and it includes you. When I say 咱们 I pull you in with me, so it feels warmer than 我们, which could leave you out.

gloss: (dialect) (in a coaxing or familiar way) you
note: You, said fondly. Saying 咱们不哭 to a crying child softens it, because it sounds like we're getting through this together.

gloss: so, actually, as it turns out
note: So that's it. You say 原来 the moment something clicks, with a small feeling of finding out what was true all along.

gloss: to part; to leave each other
note: To part, often for a long time. It feels heavier than saying goodbye, and you use it for people you may not see for years.
Model, award-worthy. 先进工作者 is an official workplace honor, and you picture a certificate and a red banner.
The top leadership in Beijing. When you hear 中央 on its own you think of the Party Central Committee, and a document from it feels final.

gloss: people's congress, a legislative body within the PRC's system of government at any of various levels – national, provincial, municipal, county or township (abbr. for 人民代表大會|人民代表大会[ren2 min2 dai4 biao3 da4 hui4])
note: The people's congress, China's legislature. You picture the Great Hall of the People each March, and you don't expect a surprise vote.
Your way of thinking, and your politics. When someone does your 思想工作 they're talking you round, at home as much as at work.
A formality, something done for show. With 走形式 you go through the motions, and everyone in the room knows it.
To argue it out and demand fairness. 找他理论 means you march over to have it out with someone who wronged you.
Sensible, done properly. When you say 这不科学 you're half joking, meaning this just makes no sense.
Lively, sharp, well turned out. You say 真精神 to a young man with a new haircut, and it's about the whole look of being awake and alive.

gloss: in the end; as a result
note: In the end, and often not how you hoped. In a story 结果 warns you of the letdown, as in 我等了一天，结果他没来.
To serve. You see 为人民服务 on signs at government offices, and depending on the day at the counter you read it straight or with a sigh.
Socialism, and for you a word from school and slogans. You memorized the twelve words of 社会主义核心价值观 and still see them on street banners.
